transcript.text: SimAir two one two, runway three six, cleared to land.
transcript.agent_summary_unverified:

**Warnings:** none (0 new, 0 open).

transcript.text: Cleared to land runway three six, SimAir two one two.
transcript.agent_summary_unverified:
**Event:** LANDING_CLEARANCE readback from SIM212 for runway 36 (speaker_role AMBIGUOUS, resolved as readback).
**Warnings:** none (0 new, 0 open).
**Look-ahead (t=3):** SIM212 still unavailable (airborne phase not modelled). RESCUE7 is OK — occupancy window [21.5s, open-ended] in zone Z1, earliest exit at 29.5s. Prediction unavailable for SIM212 is not "no conflict."

transcript.text: Tower, Rescue seven, request to cross runway three six at Kilo.
transcript.agent_summary_unverified:
**Event:** CROSS_REQUEST from RESCUE7 to cross runway 36 at Kilo.
**Warnings:** none (0 new, 0 open).
**Look-ahead (t=24):** Both tracks now available. SIM212 is OK on final — occupancy window [40.4s, open-ended] on runway, earliest exit at 43.4s (still decelerating at 64.27 m/s). RESCUE7 is OK but occupancy shows "no_entry_within_horizon" — vehicle is stationary or too slow to enter zone Z1 within the prediction horizon. No conflict flagged.

transcript.text: Rescue seven, cross runway three six at Kilo.
transcript.agent_summary_unverified:
**Event:** CROSS instruction from ATC to RESCUE7 to cross runway 36 at Kilo.
**Warnings:** ⚠️ 1 new CONFLICT warning fired (w0001, rule R1: crossing vs active landing), 1 open — SIM212 holds active landing clearance (t=0, acknowledged) and RESCUE7 holds crossing authorization (t=28, pending). Alert posted to approved Telegram (msg 12).
**Look-ahead (t=28):** Both tracks available. SIM212 occupancy window [42.6s, open-ended]; RESCUE7 occupancy window [47.3s, 72.8s]. Confirmed occupancy overlap at zone Z1 during 47.3–72.8s (lead time 19.3s), unconditionally raised.

transcript.text: Crossing runway three six at Kilo, Rescue seven.
transcript.agent_summary_unverified:
**Event:** CROSS readback from RESCUE7 confirming runway 36 at Kilo.
**Warnings:** w0001 still open (CONFLICT: crossing vs active landing), no new warnings — RESCUE7 readback acknowledged the crossing instruction.
**Look-ahead (t=31):** SIM212 on final, occupancy window [42.6s, open-ended], earliest exit 46.4s, decelerating (50.42 m/s). RESCUE7 still stationary, occupancy window [50.2s, 75.7s]. Unconditional occupancy overlap at zone Z1 during 50.2–75.7s (lead 19.2s), same conflict persists.

**Event:** CANCEL instruction from ATC to RESCUE7 ("stop, stop, stop").
**Warnings:** w0001 still open (CONFLICT: crossing vs active landing), no new warnings. RESCUE7's crossing reservation is now `cancel_unacknowledged` — stop was not acknowledged.
**Look-ahead (t=38):** Critical escalation. SIM212 occupancy window [44.4s, open-ended], entry_latest 47.3s, exit_earliest 49.5s (decelerating at 36.33 m/s). RESCUE7 is **observed moving** at 12.03 m/s (accelerating) — despite the stop instruction, the system keeps the moving hypothesis. Overlap at zone Z1 narrowed to **47.2–55.9s** with lead time reduced to **9.2s** (down from 19.3s at t=28). No new warning fired by the ledger, but the situation has tightened considerably.

**Event:** CANCEL instruction from ATC to RESCUE7 ("stop, stop, stop").
**Warnings:** w0001 still open (CONFLICT: crossing vs active landing), no new warnings. RESCUE7's crossing reservation is now `cancel_unacknowledged` — stop was not acknowledged.
**Look-ahead (t=38):** Critical escalation. SIM212 occupancy window [44.4s, open-ended], entry_latest 47.3s, exit_earliest 49.5s (decelerating at 36.33 m/s). RESCUE7 is **observed moving** at 12.03 m/s (accelerating) — despite the stop instruction, the system keeps the moving hypothesis. Overlap at zone Z1 narrowed to **47.2–55.9s** with lead time reduced to **9.2s** (down from 19.3s at t=28). No new warning fired by the ledger, but the situation has tightened considerably.

**Clock tick at t=42** (no new transmission).

**Warning status:** w0001 still open (CONFLICT: crossing vs active landing). No new or cleared warnings.

**What changed since t=38:**

| | t=38 | t=42 | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| **SIM212 speed** | 36.33 m/s | 27.82 m/s | Decelerating ✓ |
| **SIM212 entry_latest** | 47.3 s | 46.2 s | Earlier by 1.1s |
| **SIM212 exit_earliest** | 49.5 s | 52.2 s | Later by 2.7s |
| **RESCUE7 speed** | 12.03 m/s | 12.06 m/s | Still moving |
| **RESCUE7 entry_latest** | 47.9 s | 56.4 s | Delayed 8.5s (note: stop not ack'd, but observed motion persists) |
| **Overlap window** | 47.2–55.9 s | 49.6–102 s | Shifted later, now open-ended for RESCUE7 |
| **Lead time** | 9.2 s | 7.6 s | **Tightened by 1.6s** |

**Key dynamics:**
- SIM212 is decelerating but the predicted zone occupancy window has shifted slightly — entry is earlier (46.2s) but exit window has stretched (52.2s+).
- RESCUE7 has not acknowledged the stop order, yet its predicted entry into the zone has been pushed from ~47.9s to ~56.4s, suggesting some deceleration is observed even without acknowledgement.
- **Lead time continues to shrink** (19.3s → 9.2s → 7.6s). No new warning was fired by the ledger — this is still a single open CONFLICT. The situation is deteriorating.

**Clock tick at t=48** (no new transmission).

**Warning status:** w0001 still open. No new or cleared warnings.

**What changed since t=42:**

| | t=42 | t=48 | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| **SIM212 speed** | 27.82 m/s | 15.72 m/s | Still decelerating ✓ |
| **SIM212 entry_latest** | 46.2 s | 47 s | Now at runway threshold |
| **SIM212 exit_earliest** | 52.2 s | null (open-ended) | Uncertain — may still be on runway |
| **RESCUE7 speed** | 12.06 m/s | 11.8 m/s | Barely slowing, **not stopping** |
| **RESCUE7 entry_latest** | 56.4 s | 54.3 s | Moving slightly earlier |
| **Overlap window** | 49.6–102 s | 51.7–108 s | Shifted later but still open-ended |
| **Lead time** | 7.6 s | 3.7 s | **Halved again** |

**Key dynamics:**
- SIM212 has nearly reached the runway threshold (entry_latest = 47s ≈ now at t=48), still decelerating but has not cleared the runway (exit_earliest = null).
- RESCUE7 has **not stopped** — still moving at 11.8 m/s despite the stop order at t=38, with no acknowledgment. Entry into the zone now predicted slightly earlier (54.3s vs 56.4s).
- **Lead time has dropped to 3.7s** — the minimum headway between SIM212 entering the zone and RESCUE7 entering it is nearly gone. This is approaching the limit of safe separation.
- No new warning was fired by the ledger, but the physical situation has become materially worse. The overlap window remains open-ended because neither actor has exited the zone.
